title: eGramSwaraj gram panchayats
description: One row per gram panchayat (GP) listed by eGramSwaraj's elected-representative report (year=2026), with the site's own published counts and what was parsed from the GP's member response.

fields.name: zp_code
fields.description: District panchayat (zila parishad) code: an LGD local-body code, not an LGD district code.

fields.name: bp_code
fields.description: Block panchayat code (LGD local-body code). Null in two-tier states, where GPs hang off the district panchayat.

fields.name: bp_name
fields.description: Block panchayat name as printed. Null in two-tier states.

fields.name: site_er_count
fields.description: Elected representatives the GP listing reports for this GP (gperCount). The collector fetches members only when this is above zero.

fields.name: site_male_count
fields.description: Male ERs the GP listing reports (maleCount).

fields.name: site_female_count
fields.description: Female ERs the GP listing reports (femaleCount).

fields.name: site_other_count
fields.description: Other-gender ERs the GP listing reports (otherCount); corresponds to gender 'Transgender' in member responses.

fields.name: members_parsed
fields.description: Rows in the GP's member response. Null when the member response was not fetched (site_er_count is 0).

fields.name: members_file
fields.description: Member response path relative to the collection directory, e.g. '10/members/93638.json'. Null when not fetched.

fields.name: members_sha256
fields.description: sha256 of the member response as received (before mobno/emailid were dropped), from log.jsonl.

fields.name: fetched_at
fields.description: UTC time the member response was saved, from log.jsonl.
